$comment: The golden set, transcribed from bhauthtrack/db/02_seed.sql.
Each case exercises one branch of PKG_LOC_RULES.EVAL_LOC and carries the
outcome the legacy system produces. `expected` is the FULL system answer --
the PL/SQL ladder AND the Java second layer -- because that is what the port
has to reproduce. Three cases (500002, 500008, 500012) come out differently
from the two layers, and a port that extracts only the database half gets
500001 is the branch-7 overlap and is the only case in this set that
distinguishes a hit-policy decision from a lucky guess.
All data is synthetic, generated from documented seed 20260822.

cases.note: THE OVERLAP. cssrs 4 (+6) and dim1 3 (+4) reach score 10 with dim1>=3, so B7a and B7b BOTH match. First-commit ordering picks 3.7.
B7b clean -- dim1 is 0 so B7a cannot fire. THEN the Java layer steps it down: BWP-2001 has zero open 3.5 beds. Ladder says 3.5; the system says 3.1.
B3 commits. Dimension 1 of 4 or more justifies medically managed care on its own, before the score is even complete.

LEGACY_OVERRIDE. Branch 0 commits before anything is read; the dimensions below would have produced 3.5. BHA-2291, ticket body 'per DM request'. DO NOT GUESS -- this belongs in the manual-review queue.

B1 termed. The ONLY path on which the engine returns DENIED, and it is an administrative denial rather than a clinical one -- which is why it needs no physician. Every clinical adverse determination pends instead.
B9. Residential requested, criteria not met. The engine PENDS rather than denying -- a nurse may approve, only a physician may deny. That separation of duties is encoded as a status.
B6 -- the dimension that inverts. cssrs 4 (+6) and dim3 3 (+3) reach 9; dim4 of 0 SUBTRACTS 3, landing at 2.5 instead of 3.5. Treat all six dimensions as severity and this comes out backwards.

The benefit cap, applied AFTER the ladder decides. Zero residential days remaining caps units to 0 and rewrites the outcome -- but NOT the level. Granted 3.5 for zero days: clinically incoherent, and what the system does.
B1 out-of-network arm falls through (-2), then cssrs 3 (+3) and dim5 3 (+2) reach 3. This is also the authorization with NO consent row -- see test_consent_atomicity.

The EDI case. The 278 carries no assessment, so all six dimensions are zero -- INCLUDING dimension 4, which fires the readiness penalty. Every EDI-submitted residential request therefore pends, carrying a reason code saying clinical criteria were not met when no clinical information was ever transmitted.
B3 commits at 4.0 even though 3.7 was requested. The ladder can grant a HIGHER level than the one asked for; a port that only ever approves-or-denies the requested level cannot express this.

The frequency pend. Three adverse determinations in the rolling year pend the case regardless of the ladder. PARITY: the medical side applies no equivalent limitation. Flagged by compliance in 2016, never actioned. Neither port nor drop this silently -- escalate it.
